supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: visible extension beyond the outer orbital margins

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: high contrast between dark black periocular and cheek regions versus a light grey/white muzzle and chin region

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: thin, relatively horizontal lower lip profile with minimal visible droop

pinna_silhouette.outer_helix_geometry: rounded silhouette with a slightly irregular superior margin

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: extensive grey/white hair distribution across the mental (chin) region
other_distinctive_markers: pronounced nasolabial grooves and deep periocular shadowing
